# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
import argparse
import sys


def transform(text, upper=False, reverse=False):
    if upper:
        text = text.upper()
    if reverse:
        text = text[::-1]
    return text


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='tool.py',
        description='Join TEXT arguments with spaces and transform the result.',
    )
    parser.add_argument('--upper', action='store_true', help='uppercase the result')
    parser.add_argument('--reverse', action='store_true', help='reverse the result')
    parser.add_argument('text', nargs='*', metavar='TEXT', help='text pieces to join with single spaces')
    return parser


def main(argv=None):
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if not args.text:
        parser.error('the following arguments are required: TEXT')
    print(transform(' '.join(args.text), upper=args.upper, reverse=args.reverse))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
